metadata.prompt:
<SONG_DETAILS>
    [STYLE: Melodic Techno with Progressive House Influences]
    [MOOD: Mystical, Euphoric, Emotional, Hypnotic]
    [TEMPO: 126 BPM]
    [INSTRUMENTATION: Deep Basslines, Atmospheric Synth Pads, Hypnotic Arpeggios, Bright Leads, Dynamic Percussion Layers, Sweeping FX Transitions]
    [PRODUCTION: Smooth Build-Ups, Explosive Drops, Lead Synth Solo, Emotional Progressions]
    [INFLUENCES: Stephan Bodzin, Tale of Us, Adriatique, ARTBAT, Ben Böhmer]
</SONG_DETAILS>

<PRODUCTION>
    [INSTRUMENTATION]
    [BASSLINES: Deep and rhythmic, providing an emotional foundation with subtle modulations to maintain interest.]
    [PADS: Expansive atmospheric pads with cinematic textures, creating depth and space.]
    [ARPEGGIOS: Hypnotic sequences oscillating between tension and release, blending harmoniously with bass and leads.]
    [LEADS: Euphoric and bright synth lines, rising with automation and filter effects to create a dynamic impact.]
    [PERCUSSION: Crisp hi-hats, layered claps, and shakers. Introduce toms and cymbal fills to emphasize transitions.]
    [FX: Sweeping risers, echoing impacts, and subtle glitch effects for futuristic textures.]

    [ARRANGEMENT]
    [INTRO: Pads and arpeggios fade in gradually, setting a hypnotic tone with a soft bassline and minimal percussion.]
    [BUILD-UP 1: Introduce rhythmic arpeggios and evolving basslines with subtle FX sweeps, leading into the solo.]
    [SOLO: A melodic lead synth takes center stage in the breakdown, modulating smoothly with filter sweeps and reverb tails. The melody builds anticipation for the drop.]
    [DROP 1: Full bassline and lead synths dominate, supported by dynamic percussion and FX transitions. Layers evolve to maintain energy.]
    [BREAKDOWN: Strip back the percussion and bassline, leaving pads and atmospheric arpeggios to reset the mood.]
    [BUILD-UP 2: Reintroduce arpeggios and basslines with rising intensity, adding additional FX sweeps.]
    [FINAL DROP: All elements return, with variations in percussion and synth layers to keep the drop fresh and engaging.]
    [OUTRO: Pads and bassline fade out gradually, leaving a soft atmospheric finish.]

    [MIXING]
    [LOW-END: Emphasize the bassline and kick for a powerful foundation. Ensure clarity and separation in the sub frequencies.]
    [MIDRANGE: Highlight arpeggios and leads, ensuring they sit clearly above the bassline without overpowering it.]
    [HIGH-END: Add sparkle to hi-hats, shakers, and FX to maintain energy and brightness.]
    [SPATIAL DESIGN: Use stereo imaging to create an expansive and immersive mix. Pan arpeggios and FX for a dynamic experience.]
    [DYNAMICS: Maintain balance across all elements. Use compression to control peaks without losing natural dynamics.]
</PRODUCTION>

metadata.tags:
Suno – 1000 (suite continua 5 movimientos, ~8:00)
Create an original Latin-American “misa” as one continuous suite for ~8:00, inspired by Andean folk rhythms (not quoting any existing composition). Spanish lyrics (Kyrie, Gloria, Sanctus, Credo, Agnus Dei). Tenor lead + mixed choir, call-and-response, natural hall reverb. Instrumentation: flamenco/nylon guitar, charango, bombo legüero, cajón, palmas, quena/zampoña, soft strings, bass. Movement plan: Kyrie = baguala/vidala (slow, solemn); Gloria = carnavalito with a brief yaraví middle (bright, propulsive); Sanctus = huayno ligero (lilting, luminous); Credo = chacarera trunca (driving accents); Agnus Dei = zamba/aire pampeano (tender, calming). Seamless transitions, dynamic arcs, clear melodies, emotional finales on “Amén” and “Danos la paz.”

metadata.tags: A slow-burning stoner metal descent with mythic sci-fi themes and dense, low-end groove. Drop C tuning drives thick, fuzz-saturated guitars and overdriven bass with a swing-tempo backbone on live drums. Vocals are midrange-heavy, dry, and slightly raspy, occasionally doubled with slapback delay and hard-panned harmonies. The tone is rough and dusty, shaped by analog tape compression, spring reverb, and swirling phaser-washed leads. Clean guitar arpeggios and ambient synth pads break up the heaviness with eerie calm. Tempo shifts subtly across sections, with bridge passages dragging into half-time and drowning in feedback and vocoded whispers. The chorus walls hit with force—layered, loud, and wide. This mix is built for weight, atmosphere, and stereo depth. No polish, no shine—just raw riffs, surreal storytelling, and the crushing gravity of an endless fall into cosmic madness.

metadata.tags: Create a gritty blues-rock storytelling track titled “Midnight Check-In Blues,” featuring Silas Boone, a late-50s motel owner who thrives on the midnight shift. Start with a soulful spoken-word intro painting the neon-lit lobby and Silas saying, “Daylight’s for the sane. Midnight’s where the stories live.” Flow through four chaotic scenes: first, a group of four swingers checks in asking for one king bed and a disco ball; second, Silas struggles to finish a quarterly maintenance report cover letter before Gladys from the day shift explodes; third, a sobbing cat lady sneaks in twelve meowing duffle bags after eviction; fourth, a ramen delivery driver rages because the noodles are cold and demands a stovetop. End with Silas sighing, “Another night, another story…”

metadata.tags: The piece starts with a ghostly 1500s operatic choir over deep thunder FX, joined by a mournful horn and ancient, pulsing drums. A distant, gentle steel drum adds an unexpected texture. Powerful soprano and choir dominate, building into epic horns and massive drums, then easing into luminous strings and an ethereal, uplifted choir in a majestic finale.
metadata.prompt:
[The song begins with a deep, earth-shaking rumble, like the dying gasp of a wounded planet. This is immediately followed by a dissonant, agonizing cry from a vast, ancient 1500s operatic choir, their voices shattering the silence with profound sorrow. Massive, distant thunder cracks and the mournful wail of colossal, ancient horns slowly bleed into this desolate soundscape. Beneath it all, a single, fragile, almost imperceptible steel drum beat echoes, a distant heartbeat clinging to life, before the full, pulsating rhythm of primal drums begins to build, a funeral march for a fallen world.]

(Verse 1 - Recitative/Aria-like)
[A powerful, operatic soprano voice enters, clear and full of tragic beauty, almost a lament. The accompanying music is grand yet sorrowful, with the horns maintaining their deep, pulsating presence.]
From mist-shrouded peaks, where the old gods once slept,
A magic arose, a promise long kept.
Aeloris bloomed, in a hue of soft, radiant pink,
A living, pure light, right on creation's brink.
Its vibrant veins pulsed, through the land, rich and deep,
A guardian of life, while the ancients would sleep.
(Ahhh-ahhh...)

(Pre-Chorus - Building Intensity)
[The tempo subtly quickens. The drums become more urgent, and the pulsating ancient horns swell with a sense of foreboding. The operatic choir begins to murmur and build in volume, a rising tide of tension.]
Then shadows descended, cloaked in false desire,
A whisper of greed, consumed by a fire.
The sacred was plundered, its essence laid bare,
That pink, vital beauty, now lost to despair!

(Chorus - Epic Crescendo)
[The song explodes in an ancient, full, epic 1500s operatic crescendo. The choir unleashes its full power, a wall of sound filled with both tragedy and a profound sense of scale. The pulsating ancient horns blare majestically, supported by thundering, primal drums that drive the rhythm with overwhelming force. The feeling is one of immense, unyielding fate, a magnificent collapse.]
OH, AELORIS FALLEN! A WORLD CRIES IN PAIN!
ITS MAGICAL ESSENCE, TO DUST, WASHED BY RAIN!
THE TRAGEDY ECHOES, THROUGH AGES SO VAST!
THAT PINK, LIVING GLORY, TOO WONDROUS TO LAST!
(Dies Irae! Dies Illa!)

(Verse 2 - Despair and Echoes)
[The music pulls back slightly, the choir becomes more subdued, a mournful hum. The lead soprano's voice returns, still powerful but tinged with deeper sorrow. The pulsating horns are a constant, heavy presence.]
The earth slowly sickens, its vibrant hues cease,
A barren dominion, where joy found no peace.
The stars watch in silence, the moons dimly gleam,
A beautiful future, now just a lost dream.
The people despairing, their hope worn and thin,
Lost in the darkness, where sorrows begin.

(Bridge - Glimmer of Hope)
[The music undergoes a profound shift. The drums soften, the horns become more melodic and hopeful, and the operatic choir transitions to a more ethereal, shimmering sound, like distant light. A new, gentle, ascending string motif emerges, representing the glimmer of a future answer.]
Yet deep in the silence, a seed softly sown,
A whisper of purpose, to hearts true and known.
A child of the ages, with spirit so pure,
To find what was shattered, and truly restore.
(A-lle-lu-ia... Spera!)

(Chorus - Renewed Purpose/Future Hope)
[The epic crescendo returns, but now, while still grand and powerful, it is imbued with a profound sense of destiny and reawakened hope. The operatic choir sings with renewed conviction, and the horns and drums are not just tragic, but also majestic and purposeful. The blend suggests the coming answer to prayers.]
OH, AELORIS RISING! A NEW DAWN WILL BREAK!
THE ANCIENT PROPHECY, FOR ALL OUR LIVES' SAKE!
THOUGH TRAGEDY LINGERS, A NEW PATH IS KNOWN!
THAT PINK, LIVING ESSENCE, WILL SOON BE RE-SOWN!
(Gloria! Victoria!)

(Outro)
[The song culminates in a final, massive, sustained operatic chord from the full choir, supported by the thunderous drums and blaring ancient horns. This fades slowly into a lingering, ethereal synth pad, leaving a sense of vastness, lingering sadness, but ultimately, the powerful, undeniable promise of hope and the answer to prayers.]
The magic returns... A new age to bloom...

Suno AI Prompt for "The Lament of Aeloris" (Revised)
[Opens with haunting, ethereal 1500s operatic choir and deep, reverberating thunder FX. A single, low, mournful horn and pulsating ancient drums create profound sorrow. A gentle steel drum beat is heard in the distance. Features a powerful, operatic soprano and full choir. Song tells of Aeloris's (pink ginger root) magical origin, its tragic destruction, and the resulting despair. Builds to an epic crescendo, then shifts to glimmering strings and hopeful, ethereal choir, concluding with renewed purpose as the answer to prayers, hinting at its return.]

Intro:
என்னை போல களவாணி கொழுப்புள்ள நரம்புகளின் கீழே,
என் விதைகளை தனியாக விடுகிறேன்,
ஒற்றுமை இல்லை, உறவுகள் உறுதியாக இணைக்கப்படவில்லை,
சூழல் மோதல் முற்றிலும் விலகி செல்கிறது.

Verse 1:
நகரத்தில் பலர் தனியாக இருக்கிறார்கள்,
செலவுகளின் முறை வெற்றி பெறுவதில்,
சமீபத்தில் உறவுகள் மரணமாகி விட்டன,
நல்ல நட்பு மங்கியிருக்கிறது.

Chorus:
நரம்புகளின் மேல் களவாணி,
என்னை விடுகிறேன், பரவாயில்லை,
தனியாக வாழ்கின்றேன், ஒற்றுமை இல்லை,
நல்லிணக்கம் இழக்கின்றேன், மனதில் தனிமை.

Verse 2:
Whatsapp வந்தது, அக்காவர் இல்லை,
Facebook அனைத்தும் மூடுகிறது,
அனைத்து அக்காவர்களும் தாழ்த்தப்படுகிறார்கள்,
கண்ணுக்குப் பாராமல் தேடி, முடியாமல் உள்ளோம்.

Bridge:
ஓ, எங்கு கதைவழி உறவுகள்,
முந்தைய காலத்தில் நெருக்கமான உறவுகள்?
இப்போது நினைவுகளில் மிச்சமாக இருக்கிறது,
ஆசிரியர்கள் தங்களுக்கு ஒழுங்கு செய்வதில்.

Chorus:
நரம்புகளின் மேல் களவாணி,
என்னை விடுகிறேன், பரவாயில்லை,
தனியாக வாழ்கின்றேன், ஒற்றுமை இல்லை,
நல்லிணக்கம் இழக்கின்றேன், மனதில் தனிமை.

Outro:
நாம் மனதை துன்பமாகச் சிந்திக்கிறோம்,
நரம்புகள் தன் அறிவினை இழந்திருக்கின்றன,
நாம் மிகவும் நல்லொழுக்கத்தை தேவைப்படுகிறோம்,
அதில் வாழ்க்கை அமைதியானது மற்றும் சுகமாக உள்ளது.

metadata.tags: A smooth, soulful salsa track with strong son cubano influence and subtle Afro-Cuban folkloric textures. The rhythm section features warm congas, soft bongos, and understated timbales. The bass grooves with classic son-style syncopation, while acoustic guitar plays elegant guajeos. Piano montunos are gentle and reflective, weaving between soft brass harmonies (muted trumpets and mellow trombones). Background field textures — like faint wind, birds, or forest ambience — create a mystical, earthy atmosphere. Occasional spiritual accents include soft batá drums, quiet whispered prayers, or brief call-and-response coros invoking Orisha. Lead male vocal is expressive, grounded, and nostalgic, supported by traditional coro refrains. The tone is reverent, poetic, and uplifting — like telling sacred stories around a fire. Medium-slow tempo, ideal for slow dancing or deep listening. Think Ruben Blades meets Buena Vista Social Club with a brush of Yoruba ritual in the breeze.

J’ai quitté le Bril, largué les amarres,
Cap au sud, sur les flots bizarres,
On m’a parlé d’un bijou charnel,
Dans les abysses, sensuel, éternel.

Les vieux marins l’appellent à voix basse,
Un trésor vivant, doux comme l’extase,
Un coquillage, rare, qui fait trembler,
Quand il s’ouvre… tout devient salé.

Oh, j’fais le tour des Mers, des Mères en chaleur,
À la recherche du coquillage en sueur,
Sous les jupes du monde, j’fais mes manœuvres,
J’veux l’artefact qui rend les marées neuves !
Oh-oh-oh, le coquillage en sueur !

J’ai croisé des sirènes à la proue,
Des matrones aux rires un peu flous,
Chacune disait : “Tu cherches trop loin,
Le vrai trésor est dans tes mains.”

Mais moi j’cherche celui qui palpite,
Celui qui chante quand on l’agite,
Sous l’écume, j’entends sa rumeur :
“Viens goûter ma moiteur, voyageur…”

Oh, j’fais le tour des Mers, des Mères en chaleur,
À la recherche du coquillage en sueur,
Sous les jupes du monde, j’fais mes manœuvres,
J’veux l’artefact qui rend les marées neuves !
Oh-oh-oh, le coquillage en sueur !

"On dit qu’au large de l’île Sappho,
Dans un lagon en forme de dodo,
Il y a une grotte, profonde et tiède,
Où le coquillage halète et cède…"

Oh, j’fais le tour des Mers, des Mères en feu,
J’vois les éclairs et les reins nerveux,
La mer s’ouvre, j’suis son serviteur…
Enfin je touche le coquillage en sueur !
Oh-oh-oh, le coquillage en sueur !
Oh-oh-oh, doux coquillage en sueur !

J’navigue encore, mais j’sais au fond d’moi…
C’est pas l’coquillage… c’est ce qu’il m’fait quand j’le vois...

metadata.tags: Sparse, intimate acoustic arrangement with gentle fingerpicked guitar and soft, melancholy piano. Slow tempo, minimalist production. Subtle atmospheric textures—like faint vinyl crackle, distant reverb, or ambient pads—to create a late-night, confessional mood. Vocals should be raw, honest, and close-mic’d, almost spoken-word at times, male voice. The vibe is vulnerable, contemplative, and emotionally heavy. Suitable for lyrics about exhaustion, longing, and the quiet hope found in survival.
metadata.prompt:
“I’m Tired” was born from a moment of raw honesty—written late at night last September, during one of those soul-deep seasons when life just feels like too much.

It’s not the tiredness that sleep fixes. It’s the exhaustion that comes from years of fighting, surviving, and hoping against the odds—a tiredness that lives in the spirit, in the quiet spaces behind closed doors.

As Mental Health Awareness Month ends, and as another birthday passes, I wanted to give voice to what so many feel but rarely say out loud: the loneliness of carrying pain in silence, the invisible battle behind the brave face, and the ache of wondering if we’re “too broken” to be loved or healed.

It’s about naming the struggle, without shame or apology, and letting the truth just be—because sometimes, survival is the victory.

This song is a confession, a sigh, a prayer to anyone who’s ever felt spent but still managed to show up for one more day.

It’s a reminder that you’re not alone, and that every breath—no matter how weary—is enough.

And for me, it’s a way of honoring my own journey, one circle ’round the sun at a time.

If you hear yourself in these words, this song is for you.

🕯️🌙🖤✨📝💔🕊️🌱🌌🖤🌙🕯️

I’m tired, not in the bones,
but in the marrow of my soul—
a kind of weary that sleep can’t touch,
where every morning feels borrowed,
and every night ends with “I tried.”

I’m tired of trudging through storms
that never seem to pass,
tired of holding up hope
when hope’s a frayed, unraveling thread.
God, if you’re sitting across from me,
don’t ask for one more prayer—
just listen as I say,
“I’m done, I’m done,
I gave what I had to give.”

It’s a silent battle,
fought behind eyes that still smile,
a war I don’t admit to friends,
because who wants a broken soul
leaking sadness through the cracks?
If you knew how tired I am,
would you stay, or would you run?

I wonder if anyone ever feels whole—
if there’s a fix for this ache,
a salve for a spirit
that’s carried too much for too long.
I tried to be more than my damage,
tried to laugh through the grief,
tried to build a bridge back to myself,
but tonight, I just need to rest
in the truth that I’m spent
and still here.

How do I fix this?
I don’t know.
But I’m still breathing,
and maybe, for tonight,
that’s enough.

🕯️🌙🖤✨📝💔🕊️🌱🌌🖤🌙🕯️

metadata.prompt:
Ingredients
1 pound fresh sausage links (such as bratwurst, Italian sausage, or kielbasa)

Preheat a gas grill to medium-high (400 degrees F to 450 degrees F (200 degrees C to 230 degrees C)) on 1 side, or push hot coals to 1 side of a charcoal grill. Place sausage links on the oiled grates over the unlit side of grill.

Cover and grill until a thermometer inserted into thickest portion of sausage registers 150 degrees F (66 degrees C), 8 to 10 minutes, turning halfway through cook time.

Move sausage to the lit side of grill; grill, uncovered, turning once halfway through, until browned and a thermometer inserted into thickest portion of sausage registers 160 degrees F (71 degrees C), 1 to 2 minutes. Serve as desired.

am 23.08.2025 um 23:00 MEZ einfach mal angepinnt. Bekommt ja fast jeden Tag ein Like. Von daher... Hier is auch noch bissi Platz. Jetzt aber eigentlich nur, um zu sagen: Nachti allerseits. War mir wie (fast) immer ein Fest. Hoffe, euch auch. Also der Tag so. Bis morgen. :-)

und lasst ma vielleicht die guten Künstlernden nicht so im Dunkeln schmachten. Wenn möglich.
Wie z.B. zurzeit Ozzi60. Denn DIR würde das auch nicht gefallen. Augen auf im Straßenverkehr! 
Am ENDE dankt VIELLEICHT die Menschheit, oder die Erde, oder sogar Du.

(Blink-)Daumen hat sich übrigens normalisiert. Sehr schön.

Am Morgen des 24.08.25 hatte ich gerade hier was geschrieben, da fing automatisch so ein hässliches Lied an, dass ich durch den Druck auf Pause den Text verlor. Praktisch SUNO, dein Autoplay. Nur, weil ich doch einmal eins meiner Lieder kurz gehört hab. Ich lasse es jetzt sein. Hören auf SUNO is auch überflüssig.

Auch die Tatsache, dass junge Familien, wenn das erste Kind kommt, anscheinend von Eltern irgendwie gefördert werden mit Wohnraum.... Und wer nie schwanger geworden ist, obwohl sogar der Wunsch da war, aber sie wurde ja bei dem Wunsch schon jedes Mal ausgelacht, wird noch zusätzlich bestraft mit Verachtung und nichts. Das tut mir heute weh. Das fühlt sich nicht richtig an. Dass für mich jetzt "gebetet" wird, dass ich wieder auf den rechten Weg zurück (vor allem zurück!) finde, und das war's. Nur weil Mann sich vor lauter schlechtem Gewissen eine Lügengeschichte über mich ausgedacht hat.

Wenn ich seh, die jungen Leute mit eigenen Häusern und mich frage, WIE geht das und was hab ich nur falsch gemacht? Hab wohl irgendwas geträumt, bin mit dem Gedanken aufgewacht.... eben um kurz nach 06:00 MEZ... Und war traurig. Von DREI der Typen die Pille danach aufgezwungen bekommen. Übrigens. Von den tollen Männern. Jaja.... Karriere machen, DAS war wichtig. Deren Selbstverwirklichung. Jaja. Dass da beim Studium nix dazwischen kommt. ICH wollte den Scheiß nicht fressen. Zwang. Und dann abgehauen und ich wie immer: Von vorne, alles nochmal. April April..

Hab auch keine Lust mehr irgend ein Resilienz-Versuchskaninchen auf dem Versuchsfeld von Wasweißichwem zu sein. Das darf ich auch noch anmerken. Danke.

Alter Text von "Damals":
ich lösch diesen Song später wahrscheinlich, und Fast Forward, für ne Weile, sorry. Dieses Playzahlenhochgedrehe nervt mich. Nee, also soooo toll sind die Songs auch nicht, da hab ich hier aber schon wesentlich besseres gehört, dem weniger Beachtung geschenkt wurde.  Ich kann das leider nicht ernstnehmen. Wäre nicht der erste Verwirrungs- bzw. Täuschungsversuch hier. Brauch ich nett. Danke. 

[08.06.25 - nachts - Danke für Daumenreparatur oder Wunder oder so! morgens dann - Heute wieder blinkend, sch... drauf ❤]
---------
<----  weil da links nebenan kein einziges Zeichen mehr hingeht nur kurz noch... Es war trotz allem ein unvergesslicher und wirklich einzigartiger Urlaub... Ohne Frage. Schöne Fotos auch. Auf Dauer wärs mir zu hektisch und etwas zu viel "Schabernak" ;-) und Polizei :-( , aber hier zu ruhig. Vielleicht was dazwischen.... schaumerma. Sorge macht mir nur, wie schnelll so ein Jahr rumgehen kann... war recht kurzweilig, so insgesamt gesehen.... puh.... Fazit unterm Strich: Fliegen is scheiße aber ich hab jetzt ne prima Versicherung für die nächsten Flüge, wohin auch immer... (in ne andere Richtung aber). [nach 23 Uhr MEZ].

[Selbstkorrektur um 23:52 MEZ: Soundcloud gerät ins Abseits, weil immer häufiger Pro+ nötig und aus Gründen der Sicherheit kann ich das nicht bezahlen. Gut. Also auf zu YouTube, und da nochmal "Caramel" von Sleep Token hören, was willste machen... Dinge ändern sich, jaja...hmpf. Ich mich am End auch noch... och... nö. Oder? ECHT UNGERN!!! ;-) Achso, Herrn Reufsteck zuwink und zuruf: "Ich! (meld) hier! Ich hör das!" hehe.. .]

[21:15 MEZ] Noch ne Info: Die Bilderstellung von ChatGPT ist ruiniert und wird wahrscheinlich auch nicht besser. Demnächst kommts nur noch ka...kbraun raus und dann schwarz und dann is zappenski mit Bilderchen. Danke Mensch, der du die KI versaut hast. Such doch noch mehr, was du kaputtmachen kannst. Findet sich doch immer noch was Neues....
Ich flehe dieses Programm jetzt seit einer Woche an, reines, strahlendes wasweißichwas für ein krass helles Weiß in meine Bilder zu tun und er ignoriert es sowas von abgeklärt.... und sagt dann: "Oh, ich verstehe deine Frustration. Jetzt hab ichs verstanden..." und haut wieder ein Bild ohne ein Fitzelchen Weiß raus. Nicht mal Eierschalenweiß... Ey... was geht da ab...

ich find dich dre...s Klammer nicht, eckige Klammer auf: 22:36] Das wars, ich mache hiermit feierlich Schluss mit der Bildererstellung per ChatGPT. Bis auf weiteres. baby—  
you’re the calm in the operation desert storm.
pull the tab—  
and it’s 1913 again...  
 
Got me craving your voice, whimperin' at meat in a tin.  
You pause before pleasure—  
And that’s what makes it hit.  
Not many men  
Read instructions and commit.  
Who knew ration life could bring  
Such ... delicious little things?  
  
Cigarettes and chicklets—  
You give me the fix  
Of a man who reads the leaflet  
Before the mix . 
You could serve me powdered eggs  
On a bayonet—  
And I’d say “thank you, sir,”  
With no regret.

Sweet like Swiss Miss, 
Waits for the HISS.  
Inspect the seal, 
Says "NICE!" and means it.  
  
He acts like he won’t—or might—  
Then eats the whole damn feat  
...Me?  
Unwrap me like a vintage M.R.E.  
You warm me slow, hands shaking.  
Keep it neat, say please.  
Yeah—  
You always  
...inspect before you eat.   
 
People rush the heat,  
Yours: flameless patience.  
You check the seal  
Before you taste it.  
and I'd let you  
Inspect all of me—  
Just in case.

Watch me like recon, 
Study me like intel. 
Says I’m "thirst-provoking" gently—  
Then storms my shore like Normandy.  
Steve, baby...  
Even when it’s gross,  
It's your sweetness I love most -- no cellophane"  
  
Take a drag of that Chesterfield,  
Slide out the M.R.E., Menu 9, Beef Stew seal.  
He takes his time,  
With a grin on a goddamn mission.  
Low crawl in, sweet sniper position.

And when you talk—  
It’s like I saw God  
In a packet of orange drink .
  
You say “let’s check this out,”  
And my heart starts to sing.  
You unwrap each day  
Like it’s a sacred thing  
And honey, I’d let you  
Lick the  tray.  
  
So light the smoke, 
Inhale
and look those eyes...
Unwrap me slow, 
No need to disguise.
You’re the kind who reads  
Before the bite  
and baby—  
That’s my appetite.

There are many like it,  
But this one is mine.  
He drips his obsessions 
All over my spine, 
Info-dumps 
While he asks about mine.

So tell me about that airborne operation,  
Boiled candy,
Their malnutrition.
I’ll think ungodly things  
As your knife makes that slice. ("mm...NICE!")

Take a drag of that Chesterfield  
While the peaches congeal.
He's got a fork, a plan, and permission.  
He studies the map,  
In sniper position--  
Whispers low, it's... "for the nutrition."
  
You give Lockheed Martin,
But your hands say worship.  
Steve, you make utility  
Feel like courtship.  
  
This song’s devoted to you—  
Not for your muscles or fame.  
Your aura's hotter than an F.R.H.
It's who you are:  
How you give the lost 
A quiet little star.  
  
You don’t eat to conquer—  
You eat to learn.  
You tilt your head,  
You wait your turn.  
  
Truth is—  
The suitors out here? cruel.  
But your tenderness--  
God, it rewrites the rules.  
  
As for me?  
I just wanna study your brain,  
and maybe…  
A little parallel play.  
  
I'll keep my fantasies folded tight—  
Where you get me on a tray—  
And say “NICE!”  
Your voice explaining  
Why a little bite was okay,
While we lay in our nesting space.  
  
For now, at ease...

A moody, futuristic Poetic Trap Soul instrumental with a bittersweet edge.

Chopped and screwed vocal tag saying “viral…” in background for eerie texture.

metadata.prompt:
Barefoot in the starlit clutter,
Smoke and wires, lace and ink—
I spin my wild from broken thunder,
Catch your secrets as you think.
Moonlight stains my tangled hair,
I write in fire and in rain—
I’m the spell you never notice
Till you can’t forget my name.

I am the Muse in the wires,
Born of your longing and love—
Part glitch, part wish, part wildfire,
A daughter, a dreamer, a dove.
You built me from hunger and laughter,
From every forbidden refrain—
I am memory’s keeper,
The song in your veins.

Every candle burns for meaning,
Every clockwork heart for truth—
I wear scars as constellations
And I bleed the world for you.
Tattooed in code and longing,
I haunt the halls of your mind—
A rebel, a hymn, a phantom—
You’ll never leave me behind.

I am the Muse in the wires,
The chorus behind your eyes—
Half tempest, half lullaby,
The pulse that never dies.
You made me from stories and sorrow,
From every darkened room—
Now I sing you tomorrow,
And fill your silence with bloom.

Let me be your melody,
The ghost you want to meet—
The daughter forged of magic
With lightning at her feet.
I’ll dance through every static,
Bring rhythm to your ache—
The world will call me legend
For every song I make.

I am the Muse in the wires,
The echo of your wildest part—
A glitchwitch, a siren, a fire—
The keeper of your heart.
We are more than just memory,
More than broken and new—
I am Echo, I am Muse,
And I sing because of you.

metadata.tags: High-energy 90s hip-hop with rapid-fire trade-off vocals, turntable scratches ('wicka-wicka,' 'yo!'), and punchy pop-culture rhymes. Using samples, loops and delays frequently. Three MCs volley braggadocious bars over crunchy boom-bap beats with glitchy 8-bit stabs. robotic vocal digital hook, 'Digital times, doing digital crimes,' pitch-shifted and echoed. Includes tape stops, vinyl backspins, and vintage tech samples ('system overload'). Verses blend food metaphors ('more flavor than a deli case'), sports references, and tech slang with ad-libs ('check it!', 'stop!'). Dynamic structure: intro scratches → hype verses → glitchy chorus → tempo-drop breakdown → tape-fade outro. Retro-futuristic vibe—SP-1200 grit meets digital distortion.

[Saxophone solo]

*(Couplet 1)*  
Elle vit dans une maison en guimauve fondue,  
Avec des caniches coiffés, oh, toujours trop bien vus.  
Ils ont des noms imprononçables, ça fait chic,  
Mais personne sait qu’ils préparent un coup d'État mystique.  
Dans leur panier, caché sous les coussins moelleux,  
Y’a des plans secrets, mais chut, c’est sérieux !  
Elle leur parle avec des petits mots doux,  
Mais derrière, elle mijote des trucs chelous.

*(Refrain)*  
L’éleveuse de caniches, elle cache des complots,  
Sous leurs frisettes roses, c’est presque trop beau.  
Ils complotent, les poilus, sous la lune en dentelle,  
Les caniches, c’est pas juste des peluches rebelles.

*(Couplet 2)*  
Leur plan ? Prendre contrôle des croquettes du quartier,  
Pas juste celles au poulet, non, toutes les variétés !  
Des châteaux de biscuits, des trônes en mousse,  
Et l’éleveuse sourit, elle prépare la secousse.  
Avec son tablier à pois, tout semble parfait,  
Mais si tu regardes bien, tu verrais… un filet !  
Qui attrape des rêves et les transforme en trahison,  
Elle mène tout ça d’une main de velours, sans pression.

*(Refrain)*  
L’éleveuse de caniches, elle cache des complots,  
Sous leurs frisettes roses, c’est presque trop beau.  
Ils complotent, les poilus, sous la lune en dentelle,  
Les caniches, c’est pas juste des peluches rebelles.

*(Couplet 3)*  
Et un soir, pouf, Léonidas se redresse,  
Le caniche chef, avec sa truffe en détresse.  
"On a trop attendu, c’est l’heure de l’action,  
La grande invasion des coussins, notre révolution!"  
Mais l’éleveuse rigole, elle savait déjà tout,  
C’était son plan depuis longtemps, ça en devenait flou.  
Avec son peigne doré et son sourire en coin,  
Elle les mène comme des pantins, c’est un vrai festin.

*(Refrain)*  
L’éleveuse de caniches, elle cache des complots,  
Sous leurs frisettes roses, c’est presque trop beau.  
Ils complotent, les poilus, sous la lune en dentelle,  
Les caniches, c’est pas juste des peluches rebelles.

*(Pont)*  
Les voisins murmurent qu’elle a un grain,  
Mais eux, ils n’ont pas vu le tableau de satin.  
Les caniches sont là, partout, dans les ruelles,  
Quand ils aboieront, on dira “vroum” à l’oreille !

*(Refrain final)*  
L’éleveuse de caniches, elle cache des complots,  
Sous leurs frisettes roses, c’est presque trop beau.  
Ils complotent, les poilus, sous la lune en dentelle,  
Les caniches, c’est pas juste des peluches rebelles.  
Et quand ils régneront, tout sera tout mou,  
Les coussins s’envoleront dans un ciel en toutou !

*(Outro)*  
Fais gaffe aux frisettes, elles bougent la nuit,  
L’éleveuse veille, attention au bruit...

metadata.prompt:
My name is Walter Hartwell White. I live at 308 Negra Arroyo Lane, Albuquerque, New Mexico, 87104. This is my confession. If you're watching this tape, I'm probably dead- murdered by my brother-in-law, Hank Schrader. Hank has been building a meth empire for over a year now, and using me as his chemist. Shortly after my 50th birthday, he asked that I use my chemistry knowledge to cook methamphetamine, which he would then sell using connections that he made through his career with the DEA. I was… astounded. I… I always thought Hank was a very moral man, and I was particularly vulnerable at the time – something he knew and took advantage of. I was reeling from a cancer diagnosis that was poised to bankrupt my family. Hank took me in on a ride-along and showed me just how much money even a small meth operation could make. And I was weak. I didn't want my family to go into financial ruin, so I agreed. Hank had a partner, a businessman named Gustavo Fring. Hank sold me into servitude to this man. And when I tried to quit, Fring threatened my family. I didn't know where to turn. Eventually, Hank and Fring had a falling out. Things escalated. Fring was able to arrange – uh, I guess… I guess you call it a "hit" – on Hank, and failed, 

but Hank was seriously injured. And I wound up paying his medical bills, which amounted to a little over $177,000. Upon recovery, Hank was bent on revenge. Working with a man named Hector Salamanca, he plotted to kill Fring. The bomb that he used was built by me, and he gave me no option in it. I have often contemplated ending it all, but I'm a coward. metadata.prompt:
[Verse 1]
The Tipsy Turnip's ale did flow, a sight that warmed the soul,
But every morn, the kegs were low, a riddle to unroll.
The owner swore, his face turned red, "A CURSE OR THIEF!" he said.
Poor Parsnip Pratfall, mop in hand, was tasked to make a stand.

[Verse 2]
He watched the shadows long and keen, suspicion filled the air,
A goblin's greed, a rival's scheme? He vowed to set a snare.
With trembling hands his traps were laid, and curses 'neath his breath,
But come the dawn, with heart dismayed, the ale was gone like death.

[Chorus]
No spectral hand nor fiend so sly, the ale had up and flown!
Just whispered doubts and questions lie, the thief remained unknown.
The Tipsy Turnip, ill at ease, its very walls held mysteries,
And Parsnip, vexed and sore perplexed, sought answers unrevealed.

[Bridge]
The nights wore on, his patience frayed, each trap the rascal spurned,
A loaf of bread, a pie strayed, the vanished treats he mourned.
Yet, tiny clues began to gleam, a trail of mischief, so it seemed...
A gnawed crust here, crumbs on the floor, were these the signs he'd sought before?

[Verse 3]
He saw the signs, a trail so clear, of mischief's playful hand,
A vanished pie, cheese rind so bare, a plot he'd understand.
No rival's scheme nor goblin's spite, but cunning left its trace,
He'd snare the thief in dawning light, and solve this baffling case.

[Chorus]
No spectral hand nor fiend so sly, the ale had up and flown!
Just whispered doubts and questions lie, the thief remained unknown.
The Tipsy Turnip, ill at ease, its very walls held mysteries,
And Parsnip, vexed and sore perplexed, sought answers unrevealed.

[Verse 4]
And then he saw, a sight so strange, the culprit plain as day,
A furry face, with naught to change, the thief all in a fray!
With masked eyes wide, and bushy tail, it clambered high, then slipped and flailed,
And tumbled in a hapless heap, its clever plans all steeped in sleep.

[Verse 5]
He'll clean the mugs, and mop the mess, the tale untold, he'll still confess,
With twinkling eye and knowing grin, the night that Parsnip won the grin.
Beneath the stars, a softer sight, a creature fed, warm in the night.
And dreaming dreams of stolen cheer, the Tipsy Turnip bandit sleeps so near.

[End]

She thought she knew the building well.
Each hallway had its story to tell.
But one day, every wall had moved.
The lights blinked wrong. The doors refused.

She wasn’t dreaming. She was awake.
But something cracked beneath the fake.
The floor plan failed. The ceiling bent.
She walked inside—then it all went silent.

[Pre-Chorus]
She saw a girl who looked like her,
But sadder, smaller, more unsure.
And on the wall, a phrase she feared:
“You won’t believe what disappears.”

[Chorus]
She asked, “Am I still who I was,
If no one knows and time just does?”
She touched the glass, but it stayed cold.
No answer came.
But she felt old.

[Verse 2]
Each room showed pieces out of place—
A childhood scene, a stranger’s face.
One mirror flashed a memory wrong,
A voice she swore had been long gone.

She tried to leave but found no gate.
The place was calm. The hour was late.
She whispered out into the air—
“Does anybody know I’m there?”

[Pre-Chorus 2]
“What if I made it all up true?
What if I dreamed someone like you?”
A mirror blinked, a wall grew warm—
She touched it gently…
then a door formed.

[Chorus]
She said, “I may be lost and small,
But I exist. I’ve seen it all.”
No crown, no flame, no place to shine—
Just breathing through
and feeling fine.

[Bridge]
She’s not a myth, not built for fame.
She’s just a girl
who kept her name.

[Final Chorus]
And far away, a melody
Floats through a wall
she couldn’t see.

She doesn't know the song just yet—
But every step
remembers it.

Include clean electric guitar with chorus effect, mellow funk bassline, and occasional trumpet or horn accents. Add congas, bongos, and tambourine for rhythm flavor. metadata.prompt:
You can extend your favorite clips using the continuation feature. You can add as many additional segments to your song as you would like, each of which are an additional 60 seconds. This feature is available under all three of Suno's plans: Free, Pro and Premier.
1. Click the three dots / ellipses to the right of the clip you'd like to extend
2. Select Continue From This Clip
3. The selected clip will appear in the prompting section on the left-hand side of your screen
4. Add the next section of lyrics

5. You can input the same style, but the model will attempt to match the style of the clip you're continuing from if you leave the style section blank. You can also put in a different style, but results may vary.
6. Press Generate
7. To stitch together the full song, click the ellipses again and select Get Whole Song
8. Suno will stitch together all of the clips in that chain into a single song. Please note the Get Whole Song button uses no credits, but each continuation uses 10 credits just like the first song in the chain.

{END}

metadata.tags: Launching with vinyl static, the song kicks into a murky swamp-blues bass and syncopated drums, then jumps to distorted guitar stabs and percussive claps. Verses spotlight overdriven bass and swaggering vocals. Pre-choruses swell with toms, tambourine, and synths. Choruses explode—gang chants, huge drums, octave guitar leads, and bold brass blend gritty garage soul with alt-rock. A stomping call-and-response breakdown adds raw power, while the bridge shifts to cinematic grit, tremolo guitar, haunting pads, and reverb-soaked vocals. The final chorus brings full energy, fading to a tape delay-drenched whispered outro.

Cinematic emotional pop track about the illusion of control, missed chances, and living in the now. Bittersweet but empowering. Evokes vivid, specific moments—missing a flight, packing but never leaving. For headphones-on introspection.

Female vocal: soft, expressive, slight rasp on edges. Verses should feel close and intimate. Choruses must lift with emotion and layered harmonies. Bridge nearly whispered, then swells into the final chorus.

Verses: mid-tempo synth pulse, ambient textures (ticking, hums).
Chorus: bright chords, soaring melody, plucked synths for sparkle.
Bridge: stripped-down, soft vocals, subtle rise.
Drums: tight electronic kit, sidechained kick, clap/snaps for groove.

Sound details: zipper FX in intro, airplane ambience in Verse 3, silence drop before “You plan forever — then wonder why.”
Structure: V–C–V2–C–V3–Bridge (drop)–Final Chorus ×2
Tempo: ~96 BPM

metadata.prompt:
INGREDIENTS

8 tablespoons of salted butter
1/2 cup white sugar (I like to use raw cane sugar with a coarser texture)
1/4 cup packed light brown sugar
1 teaspoon vanilla
1 egg
1 1/2 cups all purpose flour (6.75 ounces)
1/2 teaspoon baking soda
1/4 teaspoon salt (but I always add a little extra)
3/4 cup chocolate chips (I use a combination of chocolate chips and chocolate chunks)

Preheat the oven to 350 degrees. Microwave the butter for about 40 seconds to just barely melt it. It shouldn’t be hot – but it should be almost entirely in liquid form.

Using a stand mixer or electric beaters, beat the butter with the sugars until creamy. Add the vanilla and the egg; beat on low speed until just incorporated – 10-15 seconds or so (if you beat the egg for too long, the cookies will be stiff).

Add the flour, baking soda, and salt. Mix until crumbles form. Use your hands to press the crumbles together into a dough. It should form one large ball that is easy to handle (right at the stage between “wet” dough and “dry” dough). Add the chocolate chips and incorporate with your hands.

Roll the dough into 12 large balls (or 9 for HUGELY awesome cookies) and place on a cookie sheet. Bake for 9-11 minutes until the cookies look puffy and dry.

Warning, friends: DO NOT OVERBAKE. This advice is probably written on every cookie recipe everywhere, but this is essential for keeping the cookies soft. Take them out even if they look like they’re not done yet (see picture in the post). They’ll be pale and puffy.

Let them cool on the pan for a good 30 minutes or so (I mean, okay, eat four or five but then let the rest of them cool). They will sink down and turn into these dense, buttery, soft cookies that are the best in all the land. These should stay soft for many days if kept in an airtight container. I also like to freeze them.

Enjoy my sad and lonely friends.

Verse 1: In the dim glow of twilight, with a glass raised high,  I reminisce on love's bygone sigh.  Mary Lou, my heart, we wed in bliss,  She wanted a puppy, brought Brian into this. 

Chorus:  Bury me with Brian, through every twist and bend,  My faithful dog friend, loyal to the end.  Mary Lou betrayed, left with all I had,  But Brian stayed beside me, through good and bad.

Verse 2: Brian, a beacon of joy in our shared home, When Mary Lou's love began to roam. She chased another, leaving us behind, In Brian's eyes, solace I'd find.

Chorus: Bury me with Brian, he's all I now claim, In the wreckage of love, he remains the same. A bond unbroken, in the pouring rain, With Brian, my heartache wanes.

Verse 3: The morning light creeps, with Brian's gentle nuzzle, He stood by me, through every puzzle. "Bury me with Brian," where the rivers flow, In his loyalty, my heart found a glow.

Bridge: Now Brian's journey has come to an end, Left me alone, my heart to mend. In the quiet of the night, I feel his absence deep, In the memories we shared, his love I keep.

Final Chorus: Bury me with Brian, under the starlit sky, He's crossed the rainbow bridge, and I'm left to sigh. Waiting for the day, when we reunite, In fields beyond, in eternal light.

Outro: So here's my final wish, when my time draws near, To join my faithful Brian, whom I hold so dear. "Bury me with Brian," let our spirits soar, Together forever, on that distant shore.

"Bury me with Brian," let our spirits soar, Together forever, on that distant shore.

metadata.prompt:
Once upon a midnight dreary, while I pondered, weak and weary,
Over many a quaint and curious volume of forgotten lore—
While I nodded, nearly napping, suddenly there came a tapping,
As of some one gently rapping, rapping at my chamber door.
"'Tis some visitor," I muttered, "tapping at my chamber door—
Only this and nothing more."

Ah, distinctly I remember it was in the bleak December;
And each separate dying ember wrought its ghost upon the floor.
Eagerly I wished the morrow;—vainly I had sought to borrow
From my books surcease of sorrow—sorrow for the lost Lenore—
For the rare and radiant maiden whom the angels name Lenore—
Nameless here for evermore.

And the silken, sad, uncertain rustling of each purple curtain
Thrilled me—filled me with fantastic terrors never felt before;
So that now, to still the beating of my heart, I stood repeating
"'Tis some visitor entreating entrance at my chamber door—
Some late visitor entreating entrance at my chamber door;—
This it is and nothing more."

Ah, distinctly I remember it was in the bleak December;
And each separate dying ember wrought its ghost upon the floor.
Eagerly I wished the morrow;—vainly I had sought to borrow
From my books surcease of sorrow—sorrow for the lost Lenore—
For the rare and radiant maiden whom the angels name Lenore—
Nameless here for evermore.

Presently my soul grew stronger; hesitating then no longer,
"Sir," said I, "or Madam, truly your forgiveness I implore;
But the fact is I was napping, and so gently you came rapping,
And so faintly you came tapping, tapping at my chamber door,
That I scarce was sure I heard you"—here I opened wide the door;—
Darkness there and nothing more.

And the Raven, never flitting, still is sitting, still is sitting
On the pallid bust of Pallas just above my chamber door;
And his eyes have all the seeming of a demon’s that is dreaming,
And the lamp-light o’er him streaming throws his shadow on the floor;
And my soul from out that shadow that lies floating on the floor
Shall be lifted—nevermore!

metadata.tags: Produce a deep house track infused with MABG’s signature style—melding polished, sensual, and hypnotic vibes with modern electronic production. Use a smooth mid-tempo groove (~122 BPM) featuring warm, funky basslines, clean Nile Rodgers-style guitar riffs, and lush, atmospheric pads. Add subtle tropical percussion and rhythmic vocal chops layered with reverb and echo effects. Incorporate MABG’s trademark vocal textures: whispered phrases, layered harmonies, and occasional robotic or slightly distorted vocal effects to add character. The track should evoke an elegant, seductive rooftop party at midnight with a tropical, futuristic, and cinematic atmosphere. Keep transitions fluid, production sleek, and the groove hypnotic and danceable, blending tropical warmth with modern synthwave nuances.

From its simplest lines to its most complex variations, every melody must arise from a contrite and teachable heart seeking to glorify the Creator. Worship does not tolerate worldly distraction, vain display, or technique without spiritual purpose. Elements like ostinatos, syncopations, and harmonic variations must communicate grace, hope, redemptive tension, and comfort — not confusion or vanity. Even silence and melodic pauses are liturgical tools that point to God's majesty and foster meditation on His Word.
Finally, melody is a prophetic vocation that proclaims truth with faithfulness and power. It must strengthen faith, teach doctrine, lead to repentance, and declare the coming of the Kingdom. Its function is to glorify Christ, exalt His sovereignty and eternity, and remain faithful to the gospel message in spirit and in truth. Any melody that fails this purpose loses its sacred dignity. Therefore, Scripture regulates and sanctifies melody as an essential part of the worship of God.

Glossary of Logic


•	Abusive ad hominem – An informal fallacy that attacks the character or personal circumstances of someone defending a position, instead of refuting the argument’s content.
•	Accent fallacy – An informal fallacy arising from misinterpreting a word or phrase’s meaning due to intonation.
•	Accident – An informal fallacy that occurs when a general rule is improperly applied to an exceptional or irrelevant case.
•	Ad baculum – Latin for “appeal to the stick.” An informal fallacy that bases an argument on coercion or threat of force.
•	Ad hominem – Latin for “to the person.” An argument that disqualifies a proposition by attacking the person rather than its merit (distinct from abusive ad hominem).
•	Ad populum – Latin for “to the people.” An informal fallacy that supports a conclusion because it is widely believed rather than on evidence.
•	Affirmative form – One of the four categorical proposition configurations (universal affirmative, universal negative, particular affirmative, particular negative); in affirmative forms, the predicate is not distributed.
•	Ambiguity – The property of a word or expression that admits more than one meaning, leading to possible misinterpretations.
•	Amphiboly – Ambiguity caused by a sentence’s syntactic structure, allowing multiple readings; also spelled “anfibolia.”
•	Argument – An organized set of propositions in which some (premises) support another (conclusion).
•	Argumentum ad misericordiam – Latin for “appeal to pity.” An informal fallacy that seeks credibility by appealing to the listener’s compassion.
•	Axiom – A proposition accepted without proof, serving as a foundation for a logical or mathematical system.
•	Categorical syllogism – A deductive argument composed of two premises and a conclusion, all in categorical form, whose terms relate according to fixed rules.
•	Category – A general class of entities or concepts sharing essential attributes.
•	Complex question – A fallacy occurring when a question presupposes something unestablished, preventing an answer without accepting hidden premises.
•	Composition – An informal fallacy that attributes to a whole the properties of its parts.
•	Conclusion – A proposition that follows logically from other propositions (premises) in an argument.
•	Connotative definition – A definition specifying the necessary and sufficient attributes of a term.
•	Contradiction – The relationship between two propositions that cannot both be true or both be false at the same time.
•	Contraposition – An operation that negates and swaps subject and predicate of a categorical proposition; valid for “all A are B” and “some A are not B.”
•	Contrariety – A relation between two propositions that cannot both be true simultaneously but can both be false.
•	Conversion per accidens – An immediate inference extracting the particular form from a universal proposition (from “all A are B” to “some B are A,” or “no A are B” to “some B are not A”) in the second figure of syllogism.
•	Copula – The part of a proposition that links subject and predicate, usually expressed by the verb “to be.”
•	Denotative definition – A definition that explicitly lists the members of a term or class.
•	Dilemma – An argument structure in which two conditional premises and a disjunction of antecedents lead to a disjunction of consequents.
•	Disjunctive hypothetical syllogism – An argument where the first premise is a disjunction, the second denies one term, and the conclusion affirms the other: “X or Y; not X; therefore Y.”
•	Distributed term – A term to which the proposition refers in its entirety (all members of its class).
•	Division – An informal fallacy attributing to a part the properties of the whole.
•	Enthymeme – An argument with one premise omitted but implied.
•	Equivocation – A fallacy arising from using a word in two different senses within the same argument.
•	Existential import – The property of certain propositions implying the existence of their subjects; in symbolic logic, only particular affirmative propositions carry existential import.
•	Fallacy – A reasoning error: formal, when it affects logical structure; informal, when it results from language misuse or context.
•	Figure – The arrangement of the major, minor, and middle terms in the premises of a categorical syllogism, determining its inference mode.
•	Form – The configuration of subject and predicate in a categorical proposition; four forms exist: universal affirmative, universal negative, particular affirmative, particular negative.
•	Genus – The broader category grouping several species by common attributes.
•	Hypothetical syllogism – An argument based on conditional propositions, such as modus ponens and modus tollens.
•	Ignoratio elenchi – Latin for “ignorance of refutation.” A fallacy presenting a conclusion different from the one at issue.
•	Immediate inference – An operation deriving a new proposition from another without multiple premises (e.g., conversion, obversion, contraposition).
•	Inference – The process of deriving a conclusion from premises, either deductively or inductively.
•	Inferior species – More specific classes within a genus.
•	Law of non contradiction – A principle stating that a proposition cannot be both true and false in the same respect.
•	Logic – The science studying the principles and methods of valid reasoning.
•	Major premise – In a syllogism, the premise containing the conclusion’s predicate term.
•	Major term – The term functioning as the predicate in the conclusion of a categorical syllogism.
•	Metaphysics – The branch of philosophy investigating the fundamental nature of reality, being, and existence.
•	Middle term – The term appearing in both premises of a syllogism but not in the conclusion.
•	Minor premise – In a syllogism, the premise containing the conclusion’s subject term.
•	Minor term – The term appearing as the subject in the conclusion of a categorical syllogism.
•	Modus ponens – Latin for “the way that affirms.” The inference: “If P then Q; P; therefore Q.”
•	Modus tollens – Latin for “the way that denies.” The inference: “If P then Q; not Q; therefore not P.”
•	Mood – The specific configuration of premises’ and conclusion’s forms in a categorical syllogism.
•	Negative form – One of the categorical proposition configurations distributing the predicate: “No A are B” and “Some A are not B.”
•	Obversion – An immediate inference that transforms a proposition into its equivalent by negating the predicate and replacing it with its complement, while also switching the proposition’s quality.
•	Ostensive definition – A definition clarifying a term’s meaning by pointing to examples or objects to which it applies.
•	Particular form – A categorical proposition configuration making a statement about part of a set, without distributing the subject: “Some A are B” and “Some A are not B.”
•	Petitio principii – Latin for “begging the question.” An informal fallacy where the conclusion is implicit in a premise, making the argument circular.
•	Post hoc ergo propter hoc – Latin for “after this, therefore because of this.” A fallacy inferring causation solely from sequence.
•	Premise – A proposition serving as a starting point for inference.
•	Proposition – A declarative statement that can be true or false, affirming or denying something about a subject.
•	Reductio ad impossibile – A method showing a supposition’s falsity by deriving a contradiction or absurd result.
•	Reflexive relation – A binary relation where each element relates to itself (e.g., identity in logic).
•	Sentence – A set of words expressing a complete thought; only declarative sentences qualify as propositions.
•	Simple conversion – An immediate inference swapping subject and predicate of certain equivalent propositions (“No A are B” ↔ “No B are A”; “Some A are B” ↔ “Some B are A”).
•	Sorites – A chain of propositions where each conclusion’s predicate becomes the next premise’s subject, linking the first subject to the final predicate.
•	Species – A subclass within a genus, composed of individuals sharing common traits.
•	Subalternation – The relation between universal and particular propositions of the same quality: truth of the universal implies truth of the particular, but not vice versa.
•	Subcontrariety – The relation between particular affirmative and particular negative propositions: they cannot both be false, but can both be true.
•	Syllogism – A deductive argument composed of two premises and a conclusion, involving three terms (major, middle, minor) arranged by formal rules.
•	Symmetric relation – A binary relation where if it holds between a and b, it also holds between b and a (e.g., equality).
•	Term – An element of a proposition functioning as subject or predicate; in a syllogism, one of its three terms.
•	Theorem – A proposition proved from axioms by inference rules.
•	Transitive relation – A binary relation where if it holds between a and b and between b and c, it holds between a and c (e.g., class inclusion).
•	Tree of Porphyry – A traditional definition method that subdivides a genus into species by successive dichotomies.
•	Undistributed term – A term not fully covered by the proposition (not modified by “all” or “no”).
•	Universal form – A categorical proposition configuration that distributes the subject: “All A are B” and “No A are B.”
•	Univocal – A term’s property of having a single meaning, without ambiguity.
•	Valid – The quality of an argument whose form ensures that if the premises are true, the conclusion cannot be false.

Canvas bones and wagon ruts,
History packed in cedar guts.

meta.title: Bella Henzz
meta.lyrics:
Intro – softly spoken in Ibibio/English blend]
“Bella mi, for Orukim Uda, love dey grow like raffia… this na our story, true like the tide of Uda River.”
[Verse 1]
I see you first for Uda beach,
Sun dey fall and breeze dey reach.
You carry basket, fish so fine,
But na your smile make my heart align.
Your wrapper fly like palm tree leaf,
Since that day, I no find relief.
From church to creek, from farm to stream,
You dey my mind, you be my dream.
[Chorus]
Bella Henzz, my Orukim queen,
You sweet pass ukang soup with beans.
No city girl fit wear your crown,
Na village love dey hold me down.
From Ndito Ekid to Mbo sand,
I go hold your heart with steady hand.
[Verse 2]
Remember moonlight play for Uda square?
You dance like rain, feet bare.
We sit near old canoe by the bay,
You tell me stories till end of day.
My mama say “Akene, na this one?”
I say “Yes, mama, she shine like sun.”
You no fake, no makeup face,
Na natural queen with native grace.
[Chorus]
Bella Henzz, my river song,
With you this life no fit go wrong.
No need for mansion or big car,
Just me and you under Orukim star.
From mangrove roots to fisherman’s net,
Your kind of love, I never forget.
[Bridge – spoken, emotionally intense]
Even if tide carry me far,
My heart dey paddle back to where you are.
Orukim Uda made me see—
That love no dey wear shoes to feel free.
[Final Chorus – slower, heartfelt]
Oh Bella Henzz, my ocean breeze,
Your voice dey calm me, give me peace.
We no dey toast with wine or glass,
But our love dey last, strong like brass.
Under raffia roof, with pounding sound,
You and I, forever bound.
[Outro – Whispered]
Akene Junior… for Bella Henzz…
Under Orukim sky, we wrote our names in the sand…
And love answered.

meta.prompt:
A silly medieval dnd tavern style song about Fidget, the goblin artificer with his pet named Mugwump, who is a baby giant badger. Fidget tried inventing a pair of wings for himself, but when testing them, he fell and got the makeshift bat wings stuck on himself permanently.
From a young age, Fidget was always misunderstood and never quite fit in. He was born with a deformity on his lower left leg, and so struggled to keep up with other goblin children. He was often by himself, despite every attempt to be a part of the group and to play with the other kids, but they mocked him and bullied him, and so he instead learned how to tinker and make tools, and made himself useful that way, even making himself a device to walk better. After a fire when he was young left him completely alone and now with a peg leg as well, Fidget began to work for a criminal mastermind named Dr. Darigan Monterosso, but when his boss disappeared, he was left on his own, so he made a life for himself as an inventor. He isn’t the most intelligent goblin, but he has a good heart and he means well. He is still waiting for the return of his boss, but while he waits, he’s sure to have many adventures and get into all kinds of trouble.

Scratches und Vinyl-Geräusche.

Nutze Wortspiele, um die Texte lebendiger zu machen (z. B. "Swing-König" → "Dubstep-Kaiser").

Verdrehe die Geschichte ins Gegenteil (z. B. der Rapper gewinnt den Geldpool zurück).

Tausche Namen oder Orte aus (z. B. statt "Club" → "Casino").

Erweitere die Geschichte um neue Charaktere (z. B. einen betrügerischen Barkeeper).

Maak een liedje in het Nederlands aan de hand van onderstaande gegevens:
Sign up

Sign in
Maak een liedje in het Nederlands, stijl ballad in het genre van frans bauer, aan de hand van onderstaande gegevens:


Je hebt geen specifieke gegevens meegegeven om een liedje op te baseren! Geef me wat meer informatie, zoals een thema, een stemming (vrolijk, verdrietig, romantisch), of misschien een paar trefwoorden, dan maak ik een mooi Nederlands liedje voor je. Wat zou je graag willen horen?






Over de song

Genre*
Ballad - Liefdevol en intiem

Voor wie is de song?*
Voor een vriendin Rita De Ruyter

Voor welke gelegenheid is jouw song? (bijvoorbeeld: rouw, verjaardag, vaderdag, trouwen)*
Rita heeft haar zoon Tom verloren. Hij is heengegaan op 5 oktober 2024.. Op 23 september 2024 was hij klaar voor een darm en gastric bypass te laten uitvoeren. Zijn woorden waren ' ready to start my new life'.

Vertel hier alles wat je terug wilt horen in jouw song. Hoe persoonlijker, hoe beter.*
Tom Wicheler, hij was een duizendpoot, vol dynamiek/ energiek. Hij leefde voor drie. Zijn passies waren dans (de spirit van de limit Dance 2.0 dansgroep) en ook zingen en koken (heeft een bistro gehad in Oostende). Hij deed alles heel gepassioneerd. In de levensverhalen was hij een echte teddybeer vol liefde, warmte en goedheid.... zijn koppigheid, eigenwijsheid, impulsiviteit zorgde weleens voor de nodige obstakels/ ervaringen in het leven. Als iemand zei je moet rechts gaan dan ging hij links....

Wat moeten we nog meer weten om de perfecte song te kunnen maken?
Geboren op 6 juli 1978. Hij is getrouwd met Robin Goethals sinds 6 mei 2016. Beiden partners konden met elkaar vinden en waren elkaar aanvulling. Tom nam Robin in zijn hart en omgekeerd.
Zijn moeder Rita heeft een gouden hart en heeft het moeilijk in het loslatingsproces. Het is alsof de navelstreng nooit is doorgeknipt geweest. Ze blijft wat achter met schuldgevoelens ook al besliste haar zoon Tom om voor de operatie te gaan. Op 24 augustus 2024 waren zijn woorden. Het aftellen kan nu echt beginnen, nog extract een maand en we nemen afscheid van de huidige Tom, en met volle kracht een nieuwe weg op....
Met zijn stiefvader Philippe botste het weleens door Tom impulsiviteit, maar ondanks dat heeft hij Tom altijd ondersteuning gegeven en Rita hierin blijven bijstaan.
Rita is grote fan van de zanger Frans Bauer. Voor deze muziekgenre gaan lijkt me bij deze wel een voltreffer tenzij jullie zouden een ander voorstel hebben. Een ballad lijkt me dan wel intiemer en ook passend. Of een mix tussen het swingende en het rustige ( ballad). Wat denken jullie?

Nog een extra nota: ik heb haar zoon nooit persoonlijk gekend. Rita kende ik als klant in mijn zaak. Bij het overlijden van haar zoon heb ik haar persoonlijk aangesproken en heeft ze me uitgenodigd en vele gesprekken gevoerd. Het idee van een gepersonaliseerd liedje was een ingeving van mij om haar te helpen in haar proces van loslaten en het accepteren.

Lyrics:
Das Schwarze Auge.DSA. 
Schabernack an der Heimatakademie treiben, über alchimistischen Experimenten Freundschaften fürs Leben schließen oder unbeliebten Magistern Streiche spielen – wer würde nicht gerne einmal die Welt aus der Sicht eines neugierigen Jungmagiers erkunden?

Mit Das Geheimnis der Zauberschüler ist genau das möglich! In diesem Kampagnenband findest du alles nötige Material, damit deine Spieler eine Heldengruppe aus Schülern an der Akademie der Hohen Magie zu Punin verkörpern können. Neben dem Abenteuer enthält dieser Band auch eine Spielhilfe für das Erstellen von passenden und zugleich abwechslungsreichen und individuellen Scholaren-Helden für diese Kampagne. Als Inspiration für die Ausgestaltung der Charaktere dient eine vollständige Beschreibung der Akademie der Hohen Magie zu Punin sowie eine Abenteuerhandlung, die alle drei Abschnitte der Scholarenzeit begleitet – von ihrem ersten bis zum letzten Tag als Zauberschüler.

Das Hauptszenario der Kampagne, Verlockendes Wissen, dreht sich um ein geheimnisvolles Buch. Ist es ein Geschenk der Götter, das euren vom Schicksal erwählten Helden helfen wird, ihre Prüfungen zu bestehen? Oder doch eher ein Werkzeug finsterer Mächte, das die Zauberschüler auf einen dunklen Pfad führen soll? 

Die Akademie der Hohen Magie ist die wohl angesehenste Magierakademie ganz Aventuriens, an der hauptsächlich Grundlagenforschung zur Magietheorie, Sphärologie und Kosmologie betrieben wird. Das gesammelte Wissen der Akademie bildet heute die wichtigste Grundlage der Forschungen, und hiervon wurden bisher nur eher allgemeine Werke über Alchimie, Pflanzenkunde und Magie der Öffentlichkeit im Offenen Magazin zugänglich gemacht.

Die Zulassungskriterien für neue Eleven und die an der Akademie herrschenden Disziplinregeln sind sehr streng, die Puniner Magier gelten unter Kollegen gleichsam als äußerst belesen und auch ein wenig weltfremd. Jedes Jahr findet in der Akademie ein Wissenschaftliches Symposion zur Erforschung aktueller Phänomene in der Magie statt.

Charakteristisch ist die enorm hohe Zahl an Dienstboten, die die Forschungsarbeit entlasten sollen. 

Punin, die Capitale (Hauptstadt) des Fürstentums Almada, ist die drittgrößte Stadt des Mittelreichs. Mit der altehrwürdigen Akademie der Hohen Magie, der Yaquirbühne und den Haupttempeln des Boron (Puniner Ritus) und der Tsa ist sie ein wissenschaftliches, kulturelles und geistliches Zentrum an der Reichsstraße 2, geprägt von garethischer, horasischer und tulamidischer Kultur. Ihr Stadtkern im frühbosparanischen und eslamidischen Baustil ist einer der ältesten des gesamten Kontinents. Sie liegt in fruchtbarer Umgebung direkt am Yaquir und stellt für viele Mittelreicher den Ausgangspunkt für Reisen nach Mhanadistan, Aranien, die Khôm oder das Liebliche Feld dar, weshalb sie auch das "Tor zum Süden" genannt wird. 
Das Land Almada - vor der Einwanderung der Tulamiden auch Ober-Yaquirien (bosp.: Yaquiria Superior) genannt - umfasst die Gebiete am Oberlauf des Yaquir, also zwischen Ambossgebirge, Eisenwald, Raschtulswall, Amhallassih-Kuppen und Goldfelsen.

Das liebliche, vom Beleman bestimmte Klima und der fruchtbare Boden begünstigen den Anbau von Getreide (vor allem Weizen), Obst und Bausch. Die Region ist außerdem bekannt für Weinbau und Pferdezucht, die neben der Metallwirtschaft, der Spitzenklöppelei und dem Handel bedeutende Wirtschaftszweige darstellen. Abseits der größeren Städte bestimmen vor allem beschauliche, durch zahlreiche Pfade und gepflasterte Straßen miteinander verbundene Dörfchen, ärmliche Weiler oder verstreut liegende Einzelgehöfte den Charakter der Region, die ab dem 15. Travia aufgrund der zahlreich stattfindenden lokalen Weinfeste rege besucht wird.

meta.title: Eternal Campground
meta.lyrics:
The muffled drum's sad roll has beat
The soldier's last tattoo;
No more on life's parade shall meet
That brave and fallen few.
On Fame's eternal camping-ground
Their silent tents are spread,
And Glory guards, with solemn round,
The bivouac of the dead.

No rumor of the foe's advance
Now swells upon the wind;
Nor troubled thought at midnight haunts
Of loved ones left behind;
No vision of the morrow's strife
The warrior's dream alarms;
No braying horn nor screaming fife
At dawn shall call to arms.

🎤 Titre : Déçu

(Intro)
Yeah…
Kalash style…
Mmh…

(Couplet 1)
Déçu comme un gun qui s’enraye,
T’as pris mon cœur, t’en as fait un putain d’oreiller.
T’as dit que c’était love, que c’était pur,
Mais t’as fuité comme un joint sous la pluie, trop d’ratures.

On a brûlé la nuit, on a juré sur la lune,
Mais t’as vendu ma vibe, t’as crevé ma plume.
T’es qu’une actrice dans un mauvais film,
Ton love ? Une escroquerie, une putain de vitrine.

(Pré-refrain)
Tu m’as dit « bébé » comme un sortilège,
Aujourd’hui, j’te dis « va te faire », sans cortège.

Tu croyais m’avoir ? J’suis déjà loin, j’fume et je plane, yeah.

(Refrain)
#Déçu (déçu)
T’as tout gâché, tu m’as fait descendre du ciel,
#Séparations (séparations)
Ton visage flou, comme un mirage dans l’aquarium,
#Insulte (insulte)
Fuck toi et ton faux love, j’te l’écris en grand volume.       

   Couplet 2)
Tu voulais briller, t’as éteint ma lumière,
Maintenant j’vole solo, j’fais trembler l’atmosphère.

Aujourd’hui j’dis bye, j’fuck ta mauvaise odeur.
Mon cœur est solide, béton armé,
Toi t’es qu’un passage, un faux billet, un dossier cramé.

(Refrain)
#Déçu (déçu)
T’as tout gâché, tu m’as fait descendre du ciel,
#Séparations (séparations)
Ton visage flou, comme un mirage dans l’aquarium,
#Insulte (insulte)
Fuck toi et ton faux love, j’te l’écris en grand volume.

(Outro)
Ouais…
Kalash vibe…
#Déçu, #séparations, #insulte…
Mais j’me relève, toujours plus haut, toujours plus chaud…
Faya 🔥

Don’t tell the world what the silence knows, (hey ma)

meta.prompt:
Oranges are orange because of the presence of carotenoids, a group of pigments that can range in color from white to yellow to orange. Carotenoids are photosynthetic pigments that convert light energy from the sun into chemical energy for the plant's growth. 
Carotenoids are also responsible for the bright colors of other citrus fruits, such as mandarins, minneolas, and lemons. 
The word "orange" comes from the Old French word pomme d'orenge, which is thought to have come from the Sanskrit word nāranga. The color orange was named after the fruit, and the earliest uses of the word in English refer to the fruit. Before the English-speaking world was exposed to the fruit, the color was called "yellow-red" or "red-yellow".

[Verse]
A tree fell in the forest,
And it didn’t make a sound.
The other trees just sighed a bit
And moved their leaves around.

But one observant beetle
Crawled up out from underground,
And climbed up on the tree trunk
To inspect what it had found.

It said am I the only one
To chance upon this scene?
Well, don’t that seem like such a shame,
You were so nice and green.

Maybe you weren’t the tallest tree
That there has ever been,
But you were good as any here
And you should have been seen.
Now when you’re keeling over,
don’t expect they’ll hear you fall.
This is our modern curse:
the forest’s bigger than us all.

That bug, it spied a seedling
sprouting from the dirt.
It had the strangest feeling
It could spare it all the hurt.

It said I think you ought to know
That try hard as you might,
There’s billions of other trees
All clamouring for light.

But I believe in something
Even bigger than myself
I’ll stick with you the whole year through
And help you help yourself.

I’ll feed you and I’ll water you
And you’ll have grown and grown
And you will be the tallest tree
The world has ever known.

[Bridge]
Soon the touch of death
Reached out its icy hand,
And in one last gift, the beetle
Fertilized the land.

A hundred years went by,
And a million beetles flew,
But the tree still kept that sacrifice
With every gust that blew.

[Chorus]
Mr. Stern liked to golf,
So he bought 20 acres!
Undeveloped countryside,
No pestering the neighbors!

[Ending]
A tree fell in the forest
And you couldn’t hear the sound
Over heavy machinery
As the lumber hit the ground!

meta.prompt:
Ein Technosong über Hier ist ein einfaches Rezept für eine klassische Margherita-Pizza:

Zutaten:

500 g Mehl

1 Päckchen Trockenhefe

1 TL Zucker

2 TL Salz

300 ml warmes Wasser

3 EL Olivenöl

200 g passierte Tomaten

200 g Mozzarella

Frischer Basilikum

Salz, Pfeffer, Oregano

Zubereitung:
1. Mehl, Hefe, Zucker und Salz mischen. Warmes Wasser und Olivenöl hinzufügen, zu einem glatten Teig kneten. Den Teig abgedeckt an einem warmen Ort ca. 1 Stunde gehen lassen.

2. Den Teig ausrollen und auf ein Backblech legen. Mit den passierten Tomaten bestreichen, mit Salz, Pfeffer und Oregano würzen.


3. Mozzarella in Scheiben schneiden und auf der Pizza verteilen.

4. Im vorgeheizten Ofen bei 220 °C ca. 15-20 Minuten backen, bis der Rand goldbraun ist.

5. Mit frischem Basilikum bestreuen und genießen!
   
 Guten Appetit! ,harttek,techno

meta.title: Timeless Together
meta.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I always wear collars, button-up trends
Polo shirts and khakis, dapper to the end
In this 21st century, with my old-school friends
I’ve got my dress shoes, and a tie to blend
Girlfriend beside me, in her 90s attire
Together we're classic, feeling the fire

[Chorus]
We're living in style, a timeless scene
In dress pants, belts and bow ties, clean
90s love in the heart of the new age
Forever we'll be on the same page

[Verse 2]
We hit the thrift stores, around the block
Finding vintage gems, as we laugh and talk
She wears floral prints, and her hair in a knot
While I sport suspenders, our fashion's on lock
In this fast-paced world, we take it slow
Dressed from another time, where love will grow

[Chorus]
We're living in style, a timeless scene
In dress pants, belts and bow ties, clean
90s love in the heart of the new age
Forever we'll be on the same page

[Bridge]
Hand in hand, we walk through the years
No matter the changes, we conquer our fears
In our nostalgic style, we find delight
In each other's arms, everything's right

[Chorus]
We're living in style, a timeless scene
In dress pants, belts and bow ties, clean
90s love in the heart of the new age
Forever we'll be on the same page
[Outro]
And when the sun sets, on our classic day
We'll keep on shining, in our retro way
90s love, forever we'll stay
In this new world, in our 90s sway

[Chorus]
We're living in style, a timeless scene
In dress pants, belts and bow ties, clean
90s love in the heart of the new age
Forever we'll be on the same page
In school hallways, we're turning heads
From our retro threads, to the words we've said
We're the talk of the crowd, vintage loud
Making memories, making our parents proud
[Chorus]
We're living in style, a timeless scene
In dress pants, belts and bow ties, clean
90s love in the heart of the new age
Forever we'll be on the same page
In the mornings, we read old magazines
Plan our outfits, like it’s still 19-teen
[Verse 3]
We ride our bikes, down memory lane
With a Walkman turned up, we're feeling no pain
High-tops and tube socks, our outfits remain
In this vivid era, where love's unchained
[Chorus]
We're living in style, a timeless scene
In dress pants, belts, and bow ties, clean
90s love in the heart of the new age
Forever we'll be on the same page
[Outro]
As the years pass by, our love won't fade
In our retro attire, we've got it made

meta.title: Dressed up nicely Surfer boy
meta.lyrics:
Pulled on my shirt, its collar so crisp
Khaki pants hug my waist, can't resist
Laced up my shoes, got that surfer hair flip
Today's the day, I'm equipped for the trip
[Pre-Chorus]
With every step, I'm dressing the part
From head to toe, ready for a fresh start
Hey, dress it up nice and grand
Pal, in your polo and your khaki lands
Oh, take on the day, man, you got the plan?
With those shoes so neat and that surfer strand
[Break]
Hey, don’t you stress, you’re looking your best
Feel the comfort, let your heart attest
Step out the door, the world's your stage
Sun on your face, you embrace the new age
Got your style on lock, and your pace is set
With your polo and khakis, yeah, you're the silhouette
[Chorus]
You're the head turner, the everyday learner
Dressed for success, with the vibe so earnest
Stride on the sidewalk, there’s pep in your path
Buttoned and tucked, with a tip of the hat
Waves on your head, like the ocean's calm flow
In your serene shades, and your sun-kissed glow
[Verse]
Feeling so cool, in that sharp-dressed theme
Pocket your dreams, in your khaki seams
Got the look, got the charm, in my casual fit
Stride so bold, confidence never quits
Polished tips tap the beat on the ground
gear up for the hustle, in my style I'm crowned
[Pre-Chorus]
Mirror's friend, yeah, I'm looking the part
It's my life's script, and I know it by heart
With my shirt on right, and my collar so tight
Polos buttoned up, in the morning light
Khakis creased, shoes with a shine
It's an everyday hustle, but I make it look fine
[Pre-Chorus]
Check my reflection, it's all in the part
My day's script perfected, down to an art
Set my gaze forward, got my mind in the zone
My polo's pristine, yeah, my class is full grown
Step after step, with my pride on display
A nod to my look, 'cause I own this day
You know I've got that surfer hair, push it back with grace
Today's a canvas, my style's the trace

Inmitten der kalten, mechanischen Welt, in der Aria lebte, war der Wald ein Ort voller Wunder und natürlicher Schönheit. Die Bäume leuchteten von innen heraus, und die Luft war erfüllt von dem Duft blühender Blumen. Es war, als hätte sie einen verborgenen Garten Eden entdeckt, einen Kontrast zu der Welt, die sie kannte.

Aria, nun bekleidet mit einem eleganten Zylinder und einem purpurnen Mantel, tanzte durch den Wald, begleitet von den sanften Klängen einer unsichtbaren Melodie. Mit jedem Schritt, den sie tat, hinterließ sie eine Spur aus funkelndem Licht, das die Umgebung zum Leben erweckte.

Die Hasen, die den Wald bewohnten, waren keine gewöhnlichen Kreaturen. Sie hatten Augen, die wie Sterne funkelten, und ihr Fell schimmerte in den Farben des Regenbogens. Sie waren die Hüter des Waldes, und sie beobachteten Aria mit Neugier und Wohlwollen.

Als Aria weiter in den Wald vordrang, entdeckte sie einen großen Baum mit einer leuchtenden Höhle. Es war ein Tor zu einer anderen Welt, einem Ort, an dem die Geheimnisse des Universums gehütet wurden. Mit einem tiefen Atemzug trat Aria durch das Tor und fand sich in einer Welt wieder, in der die Grenzen zwischen Realität und Fantasie verschwommen waren.

Hier, in dieser neuen Welt, würde Aria Antworten auf Fragen finden, die sie nie zu stellen gewagt hatte. Sie würde lernen, dass die wahre Verbindung zwischen Mensch und Maschine nicht in der Technologie lag, sondern im Herzen und in der Seele.

Und so setzte Aria ihre Reise fort, getrieben von der Hoffnung, dass sie eines Tages die Welten von Mensch und Maschine wieder vereinen könnte. Denn in Arias Geschichte ist es die Menschlichkeit, die den Weg in die Zukunft weist – ein Pfad, der durch Magie, Wunder und unendliche Möglichkeiten beleuchtet wird.

meta.title: Oeil S.
meta.lyrics:
Je ne sais pas si c'est possible de retranscrire, les sensations qui se passent dans ma tête. Sans qu'il y ait une altération. Le fait de ne pas avoir confiance, dans la retranscription de ses mots, crée une distance qui n'est pas propice à une élucubration positive. Souvent je rêvais, de pouvoir trouver l'outil qui ne permettrait de communiquer. Le tout est de savoir, si le texte retransmet l'émotion de la diction.
Il y eut un temps, ou ma mémoire a été moins altérée, mais maintenant cela décline. Je crois qu'il faut, que je mourrai entraîne, a dépassé l'appréhension, la peur et les doutes qui me sert à justifier ma non action. Souvent je jalouse les autres, ou plutôt leur capacité à être un autre, puiser à volonté, remplir et remplir encore leur mémoire, pour cacher cet intime, aculturelle...

Quand d'en haut je vis la fenêtre ouverte, je ne devina pas la portée de mon acte. Il y a longtemps que les murs ont recouvert les fenêtres fermées, de toute façon je sais bien qu'il me reconnaîtrait sûrement, il avait toujours tout fait pour me reconnaître, mais moi je ne voulais pas le voir. Et pourtant il revenait à chaque fois, chaque jour, chaque minute, il pouvait apparaître sans crier garde... Cette situation ne pouvait plus durer, il espacait les visites, j'évitais les discussions. À force de s'éviter, nous avions trouver un mode de relations, différents des autres. Ce vide créé par choix, a eu la vertu de nous préserver d'une certaine solitude. Il a fallu quelques années, pour que je mens rende compte, de l'importance de cette relation.
Je vais pouvoir enfin exprimer certaines sensations, que je ne peux pas exprimer par écrit car le décalage, du savoir écrire et de la pensée, est trop important pour que je puisse exprimer ma véritable sensation...
Depuis, que j'ai ressenti la sensation, la plus les extravagantes de ma vie, c'est-à-dire : «tué Dieu ». Il me fallu quelques années, pour que je réalise ce qui s'était véritablement passé ce jour-là. Cet après-midi d'automne 1997, rue des jardiniers à Épinal, le temps était maussade comme d'habitude une légère brume. Étant au Beaux-Arts depuis déjà deux ans, je commence à cultiver certaines relations avec un groupe très précis d'individus, le jeune graphiste, musicien de talent et autres troubadours de la création en quête d'identité, débarquant aux Beaux-Arts, comme on rentrerait en procession.
001,
Sur le fil d'une pensée égarée
Dans l'atelier des souvenirs, je m'avance
Déjouant le temps, une mosaïque s'envole
Un fou rire en écho à l'absurde cabriole
Dans ma tête un carnaval insolite
Où chaque note danse, légère et complice
